notes: A chest for every 10,000 steps: 1st Common, 2nd Rare, 3rd Epic, 4th and every next one Legendary
Inventory: keep up to 50 chests and open them one by one or all at once, plus your boosts and items
Leaderboards for Today, This week and the Season, with bars as tall as the real steps and your lead in %
Tap a player to compare: exact numbers, lead over the next place and their curve next to yours
Team challenge: up to 5 friends, one daily goal, a Rare chest each when you make it
Weekly plan with a goal for each day, plan reminders, and a walk planner with pauses and the pace to keep
Live pace under the ring and when you reach today's goal
Rest and water reminders while walking
Personal records, a monthly report to share, and crown time and crown history for #1 players
The chest that opens is always the one shown on Home
Started quests never change: a new goal or rank counts from the next day or week, and quests grow step by step
Fixes around midnight, time zones and days the app couldn't read
